title: Non-Naturals
summary: NON-NATURALS, noun In medicine, things which, by the abuse of them, become the causes of disease, as meat, drink, sleep, rest, motion, the passions, retentions, excretions, etc. Functions or accidents

inlines.v: NON-NATURALS, noun In medicine, things which, by the abuse of them, become the causes of disease, as meat, drink, sleep, rest, motion, the passions, retentions, excretions, etc. Functions or accidents not strictly belonging to man.
